plan.subject: Understand the core principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.
plan.objective: Understand the core principles and mechanics of linear regression, including its components, cost function, and optimization techniques.

blocks.title: Linear Regression Model
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation of predictive modeling, representing the relationship between a dependent variable and one or more independent variables.

blocks.title: Cost Function (Mean Squared Error)
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function quantifies the error between predicted and actual values, guiding the optimization process in linear regression.
examples: MSE is a differentiable and convex function

blocks.title: Gradient Descent
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize the cost function and find the best-fit line in linear regression.
examples: Gradient descent is an iterative optimization technique

blocks.title: Regression Coefficients and Intercept
blocks.teachingObjective: These parameters define the slope and starting point of the regression line, crucial for making predictions.
